iti78:2.1: Dhātuso bhikkhave sattā sattehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti,
iti78:2.2: hīnādhimuttikā sattā hīnādhimuttikehi sattehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti,
iti78:2.3: kalyāṇādhimuttikā sattā kalyāṇādhimuttikehi sattehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti.
iti78:3.1: Atītam-pi bhikkhave addhānaṃ dhātuso sattā sattehi saddhiṃ saṃsandiṃsu samiṃsu,
iti78:3.2: hīnādhimuttikā sattā hīnādhimuttikehi sattehi saddhiṃ saṃsandiṃsu samiṃsu,
iti78:3.3: kalyāṇādhimuttikā sattā kalyāṇādhimuttikehi sattehi saddhiṃ saṃsandiṃsu samiṃsu.
iti78:4.1: Anāgatam-pi bhikkhave addhānaṃ dhātuso-va sattā sattehi saddhiṃ saṃsandissanti samessanti:
iti78:4.2: hīnādhimuttikā sattā hīnādhimuttikehi sattehi saddhiṃ saṃsandissanti samessanti,
iti78:4.3: kalyāṇādhimuttikā sattā kalyāṇādhimuttikehi sattehi saddhiṃ saṃsandissanti samessanti.
iti78:5.1: Etarahi pi bhikkhave paccuppannaṃ addhānaṃ dhātuso-va sattā sattehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti:
iti78:5.2: hīnādhimuttikā sattā hīnādhimuttikehi sattehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti,
iti78:5.3: kalyāṇādhimuttikā sattā kalyāṇādhimuttikehi sattehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samentīti.
iti78:9.1: Ayam-pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||9|| 79. (Tik.
